WITH gw AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (host_name) host_name,
    COALESCE(technology, 'Unknown') as gw_technology,
    COALESCE(network_type, 'Unknown') as gw_network_type,
    COALESCE(modem_name, 'Unknown') as gw_model,
    COALESCE(firmware_version, 'Unknown') as gw_firmware,
    COALESCE(hgw_mac, 'Unknown') as gw_mac
  FROM gw_info_latest
  ORDER BY host_name, started_at DESC
),
enriched_results AS (
  SELECT
    sr.*,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_technology, 'Unknown') as gw_technology,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_network_type, 'Unknown') as gw_network_type,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_model, 'Unknown') as gw_model,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_firmware, 'Unknown') as gw_firmware,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_mac, 'Unknown') as gw_mac
  FROM script_results sr
  LEFT JOIN gw ON gw.host_name = sr.host_name
  WHERE sr.script_name = 'superping'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) as "Nr. of total test",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success = false) as "Nr. of failed test",
  ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success = true)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)) * 100, 1) as "Success Rate"
FROM enriched_results
WHERE 1=1  AND success::text = ANY(string_to_array('${success:csv}', ','))
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '' OR host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${device_name:csv}' = '' OR device_name = ANY(string_to_array('${device_name:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${target:csv}' = '' OR metadata->>'target' = ANY(string_to_array('${target:csv}', ',')) OR metadata->>'target' IS NULL)

WITH gw AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (host_name) host_name,
    COALESCE(technology, 'Unknown') as gw_technology,
    COALESCE(network_type, 'Unknown') as gw_network_type,
    COALESCE(modem_name, 'Unknown') as gw_model,
    COALESCE(firmware_version, 'Unknown') as gw_firmware,
    COALESCE(hgw_mac, 'Unknown') as gw_mac
  FROM gw_info_latest
  ORDER BY host_name, started_at DESC
),
enriched_results AS (
  SELECT
    sr.*,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_technology, 'Unknown') as gw_technology,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_network_type, 'Unknown') as gw_network_type,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_model, 'Unknown') as gw_model,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_firmware, 'Unknown') as gw_firmware,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_mac, 'Unknown') as gw_mac
  FROM script_results sr
  LEFT JOIN gw ON gw.host_name = sr.host_name
  WHERE sr.script_name = 'superping'
)
SELECT 
  started_at as "Timestamp",
  host_name as "Host",
  device_name as "Device",
  metadata->>'target' as "Target",
  metadata->>'protocol' as "Protocol",
  (metadata->>'superping_score')::numeric as "Score",
  (metadata->>'rtt_min_ms')::numeric as "RTT Min",
  (metadata->>'rtt_avg_ms')::numeric as "RTT Avg",
  (metadata->>'rtt_max_ms')::numeric as "RTT Max",
  (metadata->>'jitter_ms')::numeric as "Jitter",
  (metadata->>'packet_loss_percent')::numeric as "Loss %",
  (metadata->>'hop_count')::numeric as "Hops",
  ROUND(execution_time_ms::decimal / 1000, 1) as "Duration (s)",
  CASE WHEN success THEN '✓' ELSE '✗' END as "Success",
  error_msg as "Error",
  html_report_r2_url as "Report"
FROM enriched_results
WHERE 1=1  AND success::text = ANY(string_to_array('${success:csv}', ','))
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '' OR host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${device_name:csv}' = '' OR device_name = ANY(string_to_array('${device_name:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${target:csv}' = '' OR metadata->>'target' = ANY(string_to_array('${target:csv}', ',')) OR metadata->>'target' IS NULL)
  AND ('${technology:csv}' = '' OR gw_technology = ANY(string_to_array('${technology:csv}', ',')) OR gw_technology = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${network:csv}' = '' OR gw_network_type = ANY(string_to_array('${network:csv}', ',')) OR gw_network_type = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR gw_model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')) OR gw_model = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${firmware:csv}' = '' OR gw_firmware = ANY(string_to_array('${firmware:csv}', ',')) OR gw_firmware = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${environment:csv}' = '' OR environment = ANY(string_to_array('${environment:csv}', ',')))
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH gw AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (host_name) host_name,
    COALESCE(technology, 'Unknown') as gw_technology,
    COALESCE(network_type, 'Unknown') as gw_network_type,
    COALESCE(modem_name, 'Unknown') as gw_model,
    COALESCE(firmware_version, 'Unknown') as gw_firmware,
    COALESCE(hgw_mac, 'Unknown') as gw_mac
  FROM gw_info_latest
  ORDER BY host_name, started_at DESC
),
enriched_results AS (
  SELECT
    sr.*,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_technology, 'Unknown') as gw_technology,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_network_type, 'Unknown') as gw_network_type,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_model, 'Unknown') as gw_model,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_firmware, 'Unknown') as gw_firmware,
    COALESCE(gw.gw_mac, 'Unknown') as gw_mac
  FROM script_results sr
  LEFT JOIN gw ON gw.host_name = sr.host_name
  WHERE sr.script_name = 'superping'
)
SELECT 
  metadata->>'target' as "Target",
  COUNT(*) as "Tests",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN success = false THEN 1 END) as "Failed",
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN success = true THEN 1 END)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100,
    2
  ) as "Uptime %",
  ROUND(AVG((metadata->>'superping_score')::numeric), 1) as "Avg Score",
  ROUND(AVG((metadata->>'rtt_avg_ms')::numeric), 2) as "Avg RTT",
  ROUND(AVG((metadata->>'rtt_min_ms')::numeric), 2) as "Min RTT",
  ROUND(AVG((metadata->>'rtt_max_ms')::numeric), 2) as "Max RTT",
  ROUND(AVG((metadata->>'jitter_ms')::numeric), 2) as "Avg Jitter",
  ROUND(AVG((metadata->>'packet_loss_percent')::numeric), 2) as "Avg Loss %",
  ROUND(AVG((metadata->>'hop_count')::numeric), 1) as "Avg Hops",
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CONCAT(host_name, '/', device_name), ', ') as "Tested From"
FROM enriched_results
WHERE 1=1  AND success::text = ANY(string_to_array('${success:csv}', ','))
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '' OR host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${device_name:csv}' = '' OR device_name = ANY(string_to_array('${device_name:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${target:csv}' = '' OR metadata->>'target' = ANY(string_to_array('${target:csv}', ',')) OR metadata->>'target' IS NULL)
  AND ('${technology:csv}' = '' OR gw_technology = ANY(string_to_array('${technology:csv}', ',')) OR gw_technology = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${network:csv}' = '' OR gw_network_type = ANY(string_to_array('${network:csv}', ',')) OR gw_network_type = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR gw_model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')) OR gw_model = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${firmware:csv}' = '' OR gw_firmware = ANY(string_to_array('${firmware:csv}', ',')) OR gw_firmware = 'Unknown')
  AND ('${environment:csv}' = '' OR environment = ANY(string_to_array('${environment:csv}', ',')))
GROUP BY metadata->>'target'
ORDER BY "Avg Score" DESC
